subject.title: fix(acp): ACP session startup fails when backend does not advertise thinking config

question: Should explicitly configured model-profile thinking defaults continue to apply to ACP sessions on capable backends?
rationale: Current tests and behavior say yes, while this PR removes that behavior globally; maintainers must confirm the intended contract before selecting the repair shape.

options.title: Preserve configured defaults
options.body: Apply or map configured defaults only when the ACP backend advertises a compatible reasoning option.

options.title: Make ACP thinking explicit-only
options.body: Retire ACP default inheritance and update focused tests and contract evidence accordingly.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured defaults
recommendation.body: Apply or map configured defaults only when the ACP backend advertises a compatible reasoning option.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the exact current-main spawn-default and manager-control behavior under decision.
